label: Article
description: A long-form authored piece — a blog post, news article, or essay. More structured than Note.

parts.label: name
parts.description: The Article's title — required for an Article (unlike a Note).

parts.label: content
parts.description: The Article body. Often HTML in fediverse usage.

parts.label: summary
parts.description: Short summary or lede.

parts.label: mediaType
parts.description: MIME type of the content (defaults to text/html in fediverse usage).

parts.label: tag
parts.description: Tags, hashtags, or mentions attached to the Article.

label: Document
description: A generic document — a self-contained piece of content with a title, body, and metadata. Spans foaf:Document, schema:CreativeWork, and as:Document.

parts.label: name
parts.description: The Document's title.

parts.label: content
parts.description: The Document's body — plain text or HTML.

parts.label: summary
parts.description: A short summary or excerpt.

parts.label: mediaType
parts.description: MIME type of the content (text/html, text/markdown, application/pdf, …).

parts.label: attributedTo
parts.description: The Person or Actor who authored the Document.

parts.label: url
parts.description: Canonical web URL.

label: Event
description: A scheduled occurrence with a start (and usually end) time. Aligns with as:Event, schema:Event, and ical:Vevent at the term level.

parts.label: name
parts.description: The Event's title.

parts.label: summary
parts.description: A short summary or description of the Event.

parts.label: startTime
parts.description: When the Event begins (ISO 8601).

parts.label: endTime
parts.description: When the Event ends (ISO 8601).

parts.label: location
parts.description: Where the Event takes place — a Place reference (URI) or a free-text string.

parts.label: attributedTo
parts.description: The Person or Actor responsible for the Event.

parts.label: url
parts.description: A canonical web URL for the Event (often distinct from @id for fediverse content).

label: Note
description: A short text post — the fediverse-canonical Note.

parts.label: content
parts.description: The note text. May contain HTML in fediverse usage.

parts.label: summary
parts.description: Optional short summary or content warning.

parts.label: published
parts.description: ISO-8601 datetime the note was published.

parts.label: updated
parts.description: ISO-8601 datetime of the most recent edit.

parts.label: attributedTo
parts.description: The author — Person or Actor reference.

parts.label: inReplyTo
parts.description: Optional reference to the Note this is a reply to.

parts.label: to
parts.description: Audience the note is addressed to (often urn:solid:Public for public posts).

label: Person
description: A human person — schema for data typed as urn:solid:Person.

parts.label: name
parts.description: The Person's full display name.

parts.label: nick
parts.description: A short nickname or handle.

parts.label: email
parts.description: An email address.

parts.label: homepage
parts.description: URL of the Person's primary website.

parts.label: img
parts.description: URL of an image of the Person.

parts.label: knows
parts.description: Other People this Person knows. Each entry is a WebID URI.

label: Tracker
description: A container for tracking work items — typically a list of iCalendar Vtodos. The list-level counterpart to single-task Vtodo.

parts.label: title
parts.description: The Tracker's display name (e.g. "Today", "Backlog").

parts.label: created
parts.description: When the Tracker was created (ISO 8601).

parts.label: modified
parts.description: When the Tracker was most recently updated (ISO 8601).

parts.label: initialState
parts.description: iCalendar status assigned to newly-created Vtodos in this Tracker (default: NEEDS-ACTION).

parts.label: issue
parts.description: The Vtodos this Tracker contains. Each entry is a Vtodo (inline) or a reference (string/object @id).

label: VerifiableCredential
description: A W3C Verifiable Credential — a tamper-evident, cryptographically-signed claim made by an issuer about a subject.

parts.label: issuer
parts.description: The party that issued the credential. Either an IRI or an Object with @id and optional metadata.

parts.label: issuanceDate
parts.description: When the credential was issued (ISO 8601). VC 1.x.

parts.label: validFrom
parts.description: When the credential becomes valid (ISO 8601). VC 2.0 alternative to issuanceDate.

parts.label: expirationDate
parts.description: When the credential expires (ISO 8601). VC 1.x.

parts.label: validUntil
parts.description: When the credential ceases to be valid (ISO 8601). VC 2.0 alternative to expirationDate.

parts.label: credentialSubject
parts.description: The entity the credential makes claims about. Object (one subject) or array (many subjects). Each carries @id and arbitrary claim properties.

parts.label: credentialStatus
parts.description: Reference to a status mechanism (revocation list, status list).

parts.label: proof
parts.description: Cryptographic proof — issuer signature. Object (one proof) or array (multiple proofs).

label: Vtodo
description: An iCalendar to-do item — a task with status, priority, and optional due dates. RFC 5545 compatible.

parts.label: summary
parts.description: The task title — what to do.

parts.label: description
parts.description: Longer-form description or notes.

parts.label: dtstart
parts.description: When the task becomes actionable (ISO 8601).

parts.label: due
parts.description: Due date-time — the deadline (ISO 8601).

parts.label: duration
parts.description: How long the task is expected to take (xsd:duration, e.g. PT30M).

parts.label: status
parts.description: iCalendar Vtodo status enum (RFC 5545).

parts.label: priority
parts.description: Priority 0 (undefined) through 9 (lowest); 1 is highest. RFC 5545 §3.8.1.9.

parts.label: completed
parts.description: When the task was marked complete (ISO 8601).

parts.label: categories
parts.description: Tags / categories for the task.
